Act as an adversarial implementation/QA agent for the proposed DEFAULT on-screen steering wheel in Racing26. Inspect current mobile controls and identify failure modes: steering sign inversion, dead zones, pointer leaving the wheel, lost capture, two-finger pedal+steer conflicts, orientation changes, iPhone/iPad Safari text selection/callout/drag, double-tap zoom, accidental scrolling, wheel sticking after menu/reset, input priority conflicts with keyboard/mouse, full-lock discontinuities, and accessibility regressions. Then implement the fixes you believe are necessary with deterministic tests. Prefer small robust helpers that can be unit tested. Do not change tire/vehicle physics. Require npm run test:mobile, steering tests, conventions, strict M5 validation, and build.
